name: pinkslip
description: Early-career job discovery, alerts, and application tooling

scripts.deploy: bun scripts/deploy-mode-note.ts web && bun run db:migrate:remote && bun run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --keep-vars
scripts.deploy:backend: bun scripts/deploy-mode-note.ts backend && bun run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.backend.toml --keep-vars
scripts.check: bun run check:frontend && bun run check:worker-types && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun --filter @pinkslip/core check && bun --filter @pinkslip/client check && bun --filter @pinkslip/client lint:css && bun --filter @pinkslip/web check && bun run check:e2e:web && bun --filter @pinkslip/ios check && bun --filter @pinkslip/webapp check:worker-types && bun --filter @pinkslip/webapp check && bun run check:e2e:react
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && wrangler d1 migrations apply pinkslip --local
